ev.q: Overall, arrivals by ambulance accounted for 14.2% (approximately 16 million) of visits to emergency departments (EDs) in 2003.
Approximately 50% of adults aged > 85 years arrived at EDs by ambulance, compared with 4% of children aged < 12 years.
